selection_process: Selection will be made through a walk-in interview conducted at the designated hospital venue.
how_to_apply: Click the online application form link provided in the notification.
Fill out the required data in the Google form.
Submit the form to receive an auto-generated email containing your prefilled application form.
Take a printout of the prefilled application form.
Gather all original certificates, self-attested photocopies of documents, and five passport-size photographs.
Report in person to the Conference Hall, 3rd Floor, Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-17 on 13.10.2026 between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.
important_instructions: Appointment will be initially for a period of 89 days, or till regular candidates join, whichever is earlier. If reserved candidates are not available, posts earmarked to them shall be filled from General/Unreserved candidates on adhoc basis for 44 days. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Registration for interview will be done through the online link; no candidate will be entertained after 11:00 AM. No physical application will be accepted directly without online form submission. Selected candidates shall be allowed a maximum of 07 days for joining from the date of acceptance, failing which the offer shall stand cancelled. OBC candidates must possess a non-Creamy layer certificate along with caste certificate on or before the cut-off date, adhering strictly to GNCT Delhi guidelines. The hospital reserves the right to change the number of vacancies or withdraw the process without notice.

rows.post: Senior Resident (Radiology, Anesthesia, Microbiology, Surgery, Paediatrics)
rows.qualification_required: 1. MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma or any other equivalent qualification in the concerned specialty recognized by Medical Council of India. In case PG Candidate is not available, Non-PG with at least two years experience in concerned specialty in Govt./Govt. empanelled hospital will be considered.2. Registered with Delhi Medical Council (only qualification incorporated in DMC will be considered) and have not completed three years Senior Residency.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PT MMMH Recruitment
content_sections.text: Click the online application form link provided in the notification. Fill out the required data in the Google form. Submit the form to receive an auto-generated email containing your prefilled application form. Take a printout of the prefilled application form. Gather all original certificates, self-attested photocopies of documents, and five passport-size photographs. Report in person to the Conference Hall, 3rd Floor, Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-17 on 13.10.2026 between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Date of Birth (Class X certificate) DMC Registration (as applicable) SC/ST/OBC Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority (if applicable) MBBS degree MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma certificate (for SRs only) MBBS Mark sheets MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma mark sheets Attempt certificate Copies of any other relevant documents Experience Certificate Undertaking, if any Five passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: PT MMMH Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Appointment will be initially for a period of 89 days, or till regular candidates join, whichever is earlier. If reserved candidates are not available, posts earmarked to them shall be filled from General/Unreserved candidates on adhoc basis for 44 days. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. Registration for interview will be done through the online link; no candidate will be entertained after 11:00 AM. No physical application will be accepted directly without online form submission. Selected candidates shall be allowed a maximum of 07 days for joining from the date of acceptance, failing which the offer shall stand cancelled. OBC candidates must possess a non-Creamy layer certificate along with caste certificate on or before the cut-off date, adhering strictly to GNCT Delhi guidelines. The hospital reserves the right to change the number of vacancies or withdraw the process without notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is PT MMMH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital has released an advertisement for the recruitment of 9 Senior Residents on an emergent adhoc basis across various specialties.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 09 vacancies available for Senior Residents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 13 October 2026 from 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MBBS with a PG Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty recognized by MCI, or Non-PG with at least two years of experience in the concerned specialty, along with valid Delhi Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 45 years as on the date of interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the online application form via the provided link, take a printout of the auto-generated email response, and report for the walk-in interview with all original and attested documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or pay scale?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Basic Pay in Level-11 as per the 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for a period of 89 days, or till a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Conference Hall, 3rd Floor, Pt. Madan Mohan Malaviya Hospital, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi-110017.
